note: Dated Pokémon GO release corrections applied on top of catalog.v1.json. `forms` adds forms the generated catalog lacks (Normal and Shiny only). `entries` changes availability: the date it took effect, the Pokémon (dex for the default species, or formId), the categories, and the official link. status defaults to "released"; use "unreleased" or "ineligible" to correct a mistake. Newer entries win. See catalog/README.md.

entries.note: Toxel and Shiny Toxel hatch from 10 km Eggs during Into the Wild, the officially dated global debut. Tradeable and size/IV categories follow Normal; no Shadow or Purified debut is established.
Sinistea debuts in one-star raids and Collection Challenge encounters. Shiny is dated separately.
Polteageist is obtainable by evolving Sinistea with 50 Candy, explicitly described in the debut post.
Shiny Sinistea debuts during Halloween Part I in wild encounters and one-star raids.
Shiny Polteageist is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Sinistea; the official Just My Cup of Tea post establishes that evolution. See the L1 audit for both sources.
Maschiff debuts in Mega Squads, obtainable through GO Pass from September 8. Reproduces the existing reviewed correction with dated provenance.
Mabosstiff is obtainable by evolving Maschiff with 50 Candy, explicitly described in the debut post. Reproduces the existing reviewed correction.
Shiny Flamigo debuts in Mega Squads wild encounters. Reproduces the existing reviewed correction with dated provenance.
Shiny Applin debuts during Harvest Festival 2026 in wild encounters and near Mossy Lure Modules.
Shiny Flapple is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Applin. Sweet Discoveries 2025 officially establishes the Tart Apple evolution; see the L1 audit.
Shiny Appletun is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Applin. Sweet Discoveries 2025 officially establishes the Sweet Apple evolution; see the L1 audit.
Shiny Dipplin is obtainable by evolving debuting Shiny Applin. Harvest Festival 2025 officially establishes the Syrupy Apple evolution; see the L1 audit.
Shiny Hydrapple is obtainable by evolving Shiny Dipplin. Harvest Festival 2025 officially establishes the Candy and buddy-catch requirements; see the L1 audit.
